record.paper_title: Open Problems Related to Algebraic Attacks on Stream Ciphers
record.original_question: For balanced Boolean functions of n variables, determine the average value of the algebraic immunity, where the algebraic immunity AI(f) is the smallest degree of a nonzero function in AN(f)∪AN(1+f).

evidence.quote: Definition 2. The algebraic immunity of a Boolean function f, denoted by AI(f), is the lowest degree achieved by a nonzero function in AN(f)∪AN(1 + f).
Open problem 5. Determine the average value of the algebraic immunity for a balanced function of n variables.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{F}_2 = \{0,1\}$ and let $\mathcal{B}_n$ denote the set of Boolean functions $f : \mathbb{F}_2^n \to \mathbb{F}_2$. A function $f \in \mathcal{B}_n$ is called balanced if $|\{x \in \mathbb{F}_2^n : f(x)=1\}| = 2^{n-1}$. For $f \in \mathcal{B}_n$, define the set of annihilators
$$\mathrm{AN}(f) = \{ g \in \mathcal{B}_n : f \cdot g = 0 \},$$
and define the algebraic immunity of $f$ by
$$\mathrm{AI}(f) = \min\{ \deg(g) : g \neq 0,\ g \in \mathrm{AN}(f) \cup \mathrm{AN}(1+f) \},$$
where $\deg(g)$ is the degree of $g$ as a multilinear polynomial in $\mathbb{F}_2[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(x_i^2-x_i)$.

Let $\mathcal{B}_n^{\mathrm{bal}}$ denote the set of balanced Boolean functions in $n$ variables. Determine, as a function of $n$, the average value
$$\mathbb{E}_n := \frac{1}{|\mathcal{B}_n^{\mathrm{bal}}|} \sum_{f \in \mathcal{B}_n^{\mathrm{bal}}} \mathrm{AI}(f),$$
i.e., the expected algebraic immunity of a uniformly random balanced Boolean function of $n$ variables.
artifact.status_search_result: The literature provides asymptotic lower bounds on the algebraic immunity of random (balanced) Boolean functions and constructions achieving optimal algebraic immunity ⌈n/2⌉, but no closed-form or exact expression for the average algebraic immunity of a uniformly random balanced n-variable Boolean function appears to be known. The question is generally treated as still open.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic lower bound on the algebraic immunity of random balanced multi-output Boolean functions
status_evidence.snippet: extends results on the algebraic immunity of random balanced Boolean functions into an asymptotic lower bound
status_evidence.claim: Only asymptotic lower bounds, not exact averages, are established for random balanced Boolean functions.

status_evidence.title: Some results on the algebraic immunity of Boolean functions
status_evidence.snippet: Studies bounds and properties of algebraic immunity for Boolean functions.
status_evidence.claim: Research focuses on bounds and constructions; no exact average AI formula is given.
